Class RedisDistributedLock

java.lang.Object
io.github.coderjeffery.distributedlock.redis.RedisDistributedLock
All Implemented Interfaces:
DistributedLock
public final class RedisDistributedLock extends Object implements DistributedLock
Redis hash lock with owner token, reentrancy and optional watchdog renewal.

      public boolean tryLock(long waitTime, long leaseTime, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException
      Description copied from interface: DistributedLock
      Tries to acquire the lock, waiting up to waitTime and holding it for leaseTime.
      Specified by:
      tryLock in interface DistributedLock
      Parameters:
      waitTime - maximum time to wait for the lock; 0 means try once
      leaseTime - how long to hold the lock before it expires
      unit - time unit for both values
      Returns:
      true if this thread now holds the lock
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the current thread is interrupted while waiting
